blocks.surface: RENDER STYLE: a material swatch taken from a soft stylized 3D diorama render of a cozy miniature office in a modern management game: matte materials, subtle soft bevels, soft ambient occlusion only inside grooves and joints, gentle fine surface detail, clean and calm, readable at small size. Perfectly even flat lighting over the whole image: no shading gradient, no vignette, no darker corners, no hotspot, no cast shadows, no light falloff. NOT pixel art, NOT a photograph, NOT flat vector. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature.
blocks.topdown: VIEW: seamless tileable texture seen straight from above (orthographic top-down, no perspective, no isometric angle, no horizon). The material fills the whole square edge to edge with no border and no objects, and repeats seamlessly on all four edges.
blocks.front: VIEW: straight-on front elevation of an interior wall section (orthographic, camera perpendicular to the wall, no perspective, no floor, no ceiling, no corners, no furniture). The wall fills the entire image edge to edge. Along the bottom edge runs a simple flat baseboard (skirting board) about one tenth of the image height, with a soft small shadow line where it meets the wall. At the top the wall simply continues to the image edge: no cornice, no molding, no cap. The finish repeats seamlessly from left to right.
blocks.style3d: STYLE: soft stylized 3D render like a polished diorama in a modern management game: smooth rounded forms, soft global illumination, gentle ambient occlusion, subtle bevels and matte materials, warm calm palette of light oak, cream, sage green, dusty blue, terracotta. Clean, calm, high readability at small size. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT flat vector. Original design, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature.
blocks.chroma: BACKGROUND: the entire background is one perfectly flat solid pure magenta color #FF00FF, edge to edge, no gradient, no texture, no floor, no wall, no shadow on the background, no vignette. Every object is separated from the others by a wide magenta gap and is never cropped by the image edge. Do not use magenta, pink or purple anywhere on the objects themselves.
